errorBoundary.title: This screen hit an error
errorBoundary.body: Something in the page failed to render. Retrying re-runs just this screen — your other work is untouched.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That URL doesn't match any screen in DevDigest. It may have been renamed, or the link is stale.

repoNotFound.title: No repo selected
repoNotFound.body: This repository isn't in your workspace — it may have been removed, or the link is stale. Add a repo or pick another from the switcher to get started.
